title: How often?
intro: Always, usually, often, sometimes, never. Today’s grammar and words, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Doim, odatda, tez-tez, ba’zan, hech qachon. Bugungi grammatika, so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Lesson 8 · How often? Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Always, usually, never…
items: I drink tea every day. I {always|never} drink tea.
I {always drink|drink always} tea in the morning.
We {sometimes go|go sometimes} to the cinema.
I {never eat|don’t never eat} fast food.
{How often|How much} do you play football? — Twice a week.

parts.title: Write the verb
items: We usually ___ (go) to the bazaar on Saturdays.

parts.title: Negatives and questions
items: Aziz often goes to the gym.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: often / How / you / do / play football / ?
usually / We / plov / eat / on Fridays
twice a week / goes / She / to the gym

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {are|is} three apples on the table.

items.prompt: Write 6 sentences about you. Use always, usually, often, sometimes, never and once / twice a week.
items.hint: Example: I always drink tea in the morning. I go to the gym twice a week.
